'''David Burnett''' (DeckTech handle '''JediGambler''')<ref name="dt-24511">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24511 JediGamler's Watto aka The Unstoppable Machine], DeckTech (David "JediGambler" Burnett, 20 July 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24511/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24511/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009050306/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24511/ Wayback Machine].</ref> posted a [[Dark]] [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]] list on DeckTech (''JediGamler's Watto aka The Unstoppable Machine''). He went 2-1 with it at the [[2002 Houston DPC]].
